svg.title: The rules' cost per scheduler step
svg.desc: The wall time of one call of vLLM 0.32.0's Scheduler.schedule() on the host's CPU in each state, on a log scale whose second axis is the box's CPU, 1.57 times as long, beside the box's steps (a voice reply's alone, 12 ms; beside held agent prefill, 16 to 20 ms; the agents' at 24 agent sessions, 38 ms), for stock vLLM, the change with its switches off (within 4.3% of stock's in every state) and the configuration to deploy (its change to the step from −33 to +1,496 µs): only lower-priority work, 16 running: 323, 325 and 379 µs; only lower-priority work, 64 running: 800, 806 and 891 µs; only lower-priority work, 256 running: 2,670, 2,676 and 2,818 µs; only lower-priority work, 64 running, a 999-block prefix hit: 1,678, 1,686 and 1,726 µs; only lower-priority work, 64 running, no prefix hit: 776, 781 and 821 µs; a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 16 running: 322, 323 and 640 µs; a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 64 running: 847, 850 and 1,217 µs; a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 256 running: 2,653, 2,675 and 3,116 µs; a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 256 running, 10 waiting: 2,614, 2,620 and 3,068 µs; a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 64 running, a 999-block prefix hit: 1,589, 1,584 and 3,080 µs; every running slot taken, 16 running: 178, 178 and 330 µs; every running slot taken, 64 running: 656, 660 and 830 µs; every running slot taken, 256 running: 2,471, 2,486 and 2,730 µs; in the serving profile, only agents, 2 running: 69, 71 and 88 µs; in the serving profile, a reply's first tokens, an agent waiting that fits, 2 running: 122, 124 and 91 µs; in the serving profile, a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 16 running: 240, 239 and 318 µs; in the serving profile, the step that preempts for a waiting turn, 2 running: 189, 197 and 664 µs.
